mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of months when UNRATE increases >0.3pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a housing sector contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a federal funds rate increase above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or combined signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate capacity utilization and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of months when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) indicate a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), a sharp monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals an imminent labor market shock that triggers recession fears, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and increases >0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
